title: fix(validation): keep JSON response format for custom validation_prompt instructions

files.patch:
@@ -36,6 +36,27 @@
 logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
 
 
+# JSON response contract the parser relies on; shared by the default prompt and
+# the custom-instructions frame so an operator prompt cannot drop it.
+_RESPONSE_FORMAT = """## Response Format
+Respond with a JSON object (and nothing else):
+```json
+{
+  "status": "pass" | "fail" | "partial",
+  "summary": "One sentence summary of validation result",
+  "items": [
+    {
+      "check": "What was verified",
+      "result": "pass" | "fail",
+      "evidence": "What was found or not found"
+    }
+  ],
+  "recommendation": "Action to take if failed (optional)"
+}
+```"""
+_RESPONSE_FORMAT_ESCAPED = _RESPONSE_FORMAT.replace("{", "{{").replace("}", "}}")
+
+

+    def test_custom_instructions_keep_json_response_format(self):
+        """Instructions-only custom prompts must still ask for the JSON verdict (#4508)."""
+        service = ValidationService()
+        prompt = service._build_validation_prompt(
+            original_message="Test task",
+            execution_response="Done",
+            custom_prompt="Check that the report mentions revenue.",
+        )
+
+        assert "Check that the report mentions revenue." in prompt
+        assert "Respond with a JSON object" in prompt
+        assert '"status": "pass" | "fail" | "partial"' in prompt
